critical_visual_components.component_note: Selected state remains visible without relying only on authored fills, shadows, or subtle border colors.
Warning, invalid, and correction states remain visually recoverable under the forced palette.

custom_control_and_icon_note: Custom controls, SVG icons, and disclosure arrows were reviewed so authored fill/stroke colors do not make them disappear or become ambiguous in forced colors mode.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews critical public routes with forced-colors or equivalent high-contrast user-agent palette override active so answer-lane state, focus cues, icons, and controls remain understandable without depending solely on the authored palette.
focus_and_state_survivability_note: Focus indicators, selected states, and critical action boundaries remain visible when the browser replaces the authored palette with the user’s limited system palette.
forced_color_adjust_exception_note: Any use of forced-color-adjust is rare and justified by better legibility or state clarity rather than by preserving branding or defeating the voter’s chosen color posture.
forced_colors_surface_label: Example forced-colors / high-contrast system-palette posture for official voter-information routes

reviewed_render_modes.mode_note: Critical routes were reviewed with user-agent forced colors or equivalent OS high-contrast mode active.

text_and_boundary_redundancy_note: Critical warnings, selected states, and next-step cues retain readable text or boundary cues instead of relying solely on brand color.
